channel_comparison.notes: Complete for Work identity, responsibility, publication and divergent version labels, issue, citation, journal scope, and article-versus-image rights. Broader Agent identity remains provisional.
The exact argument, classical disagreement, and established tag-corpus route were resolved. Picchioni and Goetze remain source-cited positions rather than newly planted Works in this bounded slice.
All five named examples were mapped to current CDLI identifiers and live source routes. No artifact, photograph, ATF, or orientation observation was admitted.

A late-2025 direct tag study and 2026 transform-sensitive method control were located. No exact newer peer-reviewed global re-dating was found; that is a bounded search outcome, not a complete literature claim.
